content: In'jan gi que'i vama atesu'faye: Ñoa'me gi que'ima in'jamba injama'choni vana'jen. Laodiceasundeccuma nane poiyi'cco ñama toya attembindeqquiama'qque gi ñajan tsain'bitsse in'jamba tsa'caen vana'jen.

Tsa'caen in'jamba gi injama'choni vana'jen cuintsu tsendeccu tisupapora fuiteccopa fae'ngae jinchopa injama'choni avujatssi'faye. Toya'caen gi in'jan cuintsu tsendeccu osha'choma atesupa “Tsa'caen tsu tsoña” qquen in'jamba Chiga tayopi condambi'choama'qque in'jan'faye. Tsata tsu Cristo.
Cristove in'jamba qui osha'cho ñotssia in'jan'choma, osha'cho Chiga in'janqque'suma'qque atesu'faya.
Qquen gi que'inga conda'je cca'indeccu ñotsse condaseqquia'caen afapa que'ima afopoensa'ne.
Ja'ño ñajan que'i'ccu can'jembi. Tsa'ma ña injama'cho que'i'ccu fae'ngae can'jenqquia'caen in'jamba gi avujatssi. Que'i Cristove ñoa'me in'jamba fae'ngatsse jacan'fa qquen pañamba gi avujatssi.
Cristove in'jamba gi cuna a'ive da'fa
Que'ija injama'choi'ccu Cristo Jesúsve in'jamba qui ccusha'fa. Tsa'caen ccushapa tisei'ccu fae'ngae jincho'ta poi a'ta tisei'ccu jacan'faja.

Quini'cco setsa'fa andenga ca'nimba quini'ccoma quiñaenqquia'caen que'i Jesúsni fae'ngae jincho'fasi tiseja que'ima quiñaen. Tsa'caen quiñaensi quini'cco canseqquia'caen qui Jesúsve in'jamba canse'faya'cho. Nane que'inga ña atesianqquia'caen Jesúsve in'jamba canse'faya'cho. Toya'caen poi a'ta que'i aya'fai'ccu Chiganga “Chigatsuafepoenján” qquen afa'faya'cho.

Injama'tse cca'i atesiansundeccu osha'cho a'i in'jan'cho osha'cho aqquia afopoen'choi'ccu que'ima qqueñasa'ne. Tsaja aqquia a'i in'jamba nafattu'cho tsu. Chigave in'jambi'choa in'jamba in'jaen'cho tsu. Tsaja Cristone in'jaen'chombi tsu.
Pa'cco osha'cho Chiga jincho tsu Jesús ai'voni ca'nimba canse. Toya'caen
que'i'qque Jesúsi'ccu fae'ngae jinchopa qui pa'cco Chiga in'jan'choma injantsse an'bian'fa. Nane Jesúsja ñoa'me osha'choma manda'sundeccuma ti'tsse na'su tsu.

Toya'caen que'ija tisei'ccu jinchopa chhiyitevaen'cho a'ive qui da'fa. Nane a'i tivei'ccu ai'voma chhiyitevaen'chombi tsu. Tsa'ma que'i Cristo a'ive dasi Cristoja que'i tayo'su a'i in'jamba tsincon'choma chhiyicatiqquia'caen pa'ccoma joqquitssian.

Que'i fetiyepa qui fae'ngae Cristoi'ccu papa atuye'fa. Tsa'ma fetiyepa sombojipa fae'ngae Cristoi'ccu qui ccase qquendya'fa. Nane Chigaja Cristoma pa'cho'ye ccase qquendyaensi qui Chiga tsa'caen ccushaen'chove in'jamba tsa'caen qquendya'fa.
Tayoe que'ija chhiyitevaembi'choapa egae tsincomba tayo paqquia'caen qui canse'fa. Tsa'ma Chigaja ingi egae tsincon'choma joqquitssiamba aqquepoemba Jesúsi'ccu ingima ccase qquendyaen.
Chiga manda'choja osha'choma mandasi shacapa gi osha'fambi. Tsa'ma Jesúsma avuja'cconga otipa fi'ttiqquia'caen Chigaja ingi shacama'qque avuja'cconga fi'tti.
Nane Jesús avuja'cconga pasi Chigaja poi joccapitssia nasundeccuma patsupa ansangian. Tise'pama patsupa poiyi'cco a'inga tsama canjaen.
Ttatta'faja sefacconi'su jincho'chove

Chiga tsa'caen que'ima ccushaensi cca'indeccu jongoesuma añe cu'iye que'ima osha'chone se'pi'fa'ni'qque tisema paña'fajama. Toya'caen osha'cho fiesta, poi canqque'fa'su, chiga ancan'cho'su, sema'ma'qquia a'ta'su fiestave'qque que'ija mecho'fa, qquen afase'fa'ni'qque tise'pama paña'fajama.
Tayo tsu tsa'caen manda'fa a'ima canjaeñe jai'ngae tsoña'chove. Tsa'ma Cristo jipa pa'ccoma tsu nanitsse tson.

Antte'fajama cca'indeccu que'inga afopoemba que'ima dañosi que'i jai'ngae isuya'choma pasasa'ne. Nane tsendeccuja Chiga attian'choma atte qquen afopoemba tsu qquen manda'fa: “Tisuma se'pipa Chigama sefacconi'su shondosundeccuma iñajaña'cho tisu ccushaye.” Tsa'ma tsa'caen manda'fa'ni'qque paña'fajama ni tise'panga dyo'fajama. Tise'pa injama'cho egasi injanga asi'ttaemba tsu tsa'caen tisuja ñotssi qquen in'jan'fa.

Tsa'caen in'jamba tisu tsovema catiqquia'caen tsu Cristo'ye joqquitssipa tisei'ccu jincho'fambi. Nane tsove tsu tsu'tta, tsain'fai'ccu ai'voma quiñaemba ñoña'su cuintsu fae'ngae jinchopa Chiga in'janqquia'caen ti'tsse'tssiave coen'faye.
Que'i Cristoi'ccu pasi va ande'su in'jamba nafattian'choja ja'ño que'ima mandambi. Tsa'can'ma ¿ma'caen qui toya va ande'su a'ia'caen canse'fa? Nane toya qui tise'pa manda'choma paña'jen'fa.
“Vama pporaenjama; tsama anjama; jovama vasejama” qquen qui in'jamba se'pi'fa.
Osha'cho tise'pa se'pi'cho tsu aqquia congomba sefaqque'suve se'pi. Aqquia a'i tsa'caen nafattiamba atesian'cho tsu.

Osha'chone tsa'caen nafattiamba tsu injama'pa'caen attian'fa. Nane majan a'i tsa'caen attiamba aqquia injanga Chigama iñajanqquia'caen tsincon'fa; tisuma se'pi'fa; tisu ai'voma vanaen'fa. Tsa'ma tsa'caen tsincon'choja barembi tsu ingi ai'vo in'jan'choma pasaeñe.
